blockedWagers.detail: MIN vs SD F5, NO on Minnesota wins F5 (economic meaning: SD leads or ties). Risk 0, Paid /bin/bash, LOSS -- placement itself was user-confirmed, but no exact execution price/displayed probability was supplied (unlike every other wager this batch). A pregame discussion referenced roughly -186 American odds, but that is explicitly NOT to be treated as the executed price absent archived evidence resolving it -- the canonical importer requires exactly one of entryPrice/entryOdds, and inventing either from an unconfirmed pregame reference would be fabrication. No archived evidence (screenshot, receipt, or displayed-probability figure) resolves the actual execution price, so this wager is excluded from the canonical ledger. Starter mapping for this game (Casey Mize = San Diego, Dean Kremer = Minnesota) is preserved here for any future reference. Excluding this 0 wager reconciles exactly to the day-level counterfactual already given in the postmortem: risk 86, paid 99.04, P/L +3.04, ROI +7.01% -- independently recomputed here from the canonical ledger and confirmed to match exactly.
